u: Creates device URIs for local and network connected printers for use with CUPS.

<dl><dt>USB IDs (usb only):</dt><dd>"xxx:yyy" where xxx is the USB bus ID and yyy is the USB device ID. The ':' and all leading zeroes must be present. (Use the 'lsusb' command to obtain this information. See Note 1.)</dd><dt>IPs (network only):</dt><dd>IPv4 address "a.b.c.d" or "hostname"</dd><dt>DEVNODE (parallel only):</dt><dd>"/dev/parportX", X=0,1,2,...</dd><dt>SERIAL NO. (usb and parallel only):</dt><dd>"serial no."</dd></dl>

<dl><dt>To specify the port on a multi-port JetDirect:</dt><dd>-p<port> or --port=<port> (Valid values are 1*, 2, and 3. *default)</dd><dt>Show the CUPS URI only (quiet mode):</dt><dd>-c or --cups</dd><dt>Show the SANE URI only (quiet mode):</dt><dd>-s or --sane</dd><dt>Show the HP Fax URI only (quiet mode):</dt><dd>-f or --fax</dd><dt>Set the logging level:</dt><dd>-l<level> or --logging=<level> <level>: none, info*, error, warn, debug (*default)</dd><dt>Run in debug mode:</dt><dd>-g (same as option: -ldebug)</dd><dt>This help information:</dt><dd>-h or --help</dd></dl>

<dl><dt>USB:</dt><dd>$ hp-makeuri 001:002</dd><dt>Network:</dt><dd>$ hp-makeuri 66.35.250.209</dd><dt>Parallel:</dt><dd>$ hp-makeuri /dev/parport0</dd><dt>USB or parallel (using serial number):</dt><dd>$ hp-makeuri US123456789</dd></dl>

<dl><dt>1. Example using 'lsusb' to obtain USB bus ID and USB device ID (example only, the values you obtain will differ) :</dt><dd></dd><dt>$ lsusb</dt><dd></dd><dt>Bus 003 Device 011: ID 03f0:c202 Hewlett-Packard</dt><dd></dd><dt>$ hp-makeuri 003:011</dt><dd></dd><dt>(Note: You may have to run 'lsusb' from /sbin or another location. Use '$ locate lsusb' to determine this.)</dt><dd></dd></dl>
HPLIP (HP Linux Imaging and Printing) is an HP developed solution for printing, scanning, and faxing with HP inkjet and laser based printers in Linux.
The HPLIP Launchpad.net site https://launchpad.net/hplip is available to get help, report bugs, make suggestions, discuss the HPLIP project or otherwise contact the HPLIP Team.
